verdict.rationale: Column's docs state that platforms can bring their own KYC/KYB process or use Column's KYC/KYB verifications with support for manual reviewing. That is a first-party onboarding-review capability and hints at a split between platform-owned and bank-owned decisions, but it is a single thin mention. Missing for 10: visibility into why an application is pending, a workflow for supplying additional documents, explicit delineation of which decisions belong to the ops user versus the bank, an ops queue or dashboard view, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
